annotations.title: Get a site's health over time

description: How a site has been doing: the share of monitors passing now (the Overview's "Monitors passing") and each of the last 30 days, the trend over 28, 90 or 182 days, each monitoring group's briefing (what needs attention, its likely cause and fix), and — on paid plans — uptime from Relvato's own probes (availability % and incidents over 30 days).
